nodes.label: Pastel Blue Gradient Background Style
nodes.rationale: The 512x512 fully-opaque canvas is a soft pastel ice-blue gradient, lightest at the top and top corners (#E6F4FE, RGB 230,244,254) deepening slightly toward the bottom (#C5E3FB, RGB 197,227,251), with scattered subtle medium-blue glows/soft blobs (RGB ~99,205,247) concentrated around the center-bottom. The palette is chosen to convey calm, trust, and warmth, which is typical for a companion/mental-health oriented app brand. As the Android adaptive icon background layer it must fill the full safe zone behind the foreground layer, hence a smooth low-contrast gradient with no hard edges.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground Layer
nodes.rationale: Design intent: a single solid light-blue heart glyph centered inside the adaptive-icon safe zone (roughly the central 66/108 region), keeping foreground art clear of the masked/cropped edges so the launcher can scale and mask it into arbitrary device shapes. Solid monochrome fill (no inner detail) keeps the mark legible at small sizes and when composited over the full-bleed background layer.

nodes.label: Blue Heart Logo Motif
nodes.rationale: The favicon is a 48x48 rounded-square icon with transparent corners, a pale blue background (RGB 230,244,254), and a single dark blue heart (RGB 0,114,222) centered in the icon. The heart motif directly symbolizes the app's core theme of emotional companionship, matching the product name 心伴 (Heart Companion). The two-tone blue palette and minimal single-symbol composition are consistent with a simple, emotion-focused brand identity.

nodes.label: App Icon (icon.png)
nodes.rationale: App launcher brand mark for 心伴AI (Heart Companion). A stylized heart rendered in a blue gradient on a light-blue (#e6f4fd) background. The heart conveys warmth/companionship (心=heart, 伴=companion). Notably the launcher mark uses a calm blue palette that diverges from the in-app rose-pink primary (#E8486F) theme, suggesting the icon deliberately targets a distinct launcher-level brand impression.

nodes.label: Heart Mark Symbol
nodes.rationale: The splash icon is a monochrome white/light-gray heart silhouette on a fully transparent 1024x1024 canvas. The simple single-color heart echoes the brand name 心伴 (Heart Companion), where 心 means heart; the minimal silhouette maximizes recognition and legibility at small splash/launcher sizes.

nodes.label: 心伴 Heart Companion App
nodes.rationale: This asset is the splash-screen launch icon for the 心伴 (Heart Companion) React Native mobile app; the heart symbol visually encodes the app's companion/heart-themed brand identity.
